description: Original polished HD-2D game pixel-art single isolated static sprite. Fixed camera looks down 35 degrees from above, orthographic-like three-quarter volume, not a flat side elevation. Clear readable silhouette, deliberately placed crisp pixel clusters, natural low-saturation midtone colors, detailed but not noisy, soft colored contour accents rather than heavy black outlines. Neutral broad diffuse daytime material color for later real-time lighting: no night tint, no glow, no colored rim light, no directional cast shadow, no ground, no platform, no scenery, no text, no checkerboard. Entire subject visible with a few transparent margin pixels, transparent RGBA background. FRAMING: Show the entire boulder fully contained in the middle of the canvas, with AT LEAST 16 transparent pixels above the moss, below the stone base and on both sides. Nothing may touch any canvas edge. Zoom out. One very large ancient MOSSY BOULDER, broad asymmetrical low mass approximately 3m wide and 1.8m high, a single continuous rounded angular granite rock with a distinctive higher left shoulder and sloped right side. Thick verdant muted olive and moss-green cushions cling across the upper surface and descend in patches, leaving substantial exposed grey stone faces. Weathered cracks, lichen flecks and mineral planes show believable heavy three-dimensional stone volume. Camera sees upper surface and front and right faces. Ground-contact base nearly horizontal, no grass, no shrubs, no ground plane, no detached pebbles. Natural grey stone midtones and green moss, not blue night shading, not tiny inventory icon, no hard black outline. All rounded moss on the top must be completely visible; rock contour closes gently along the bottom without being cut by canvas. Aim for object bounding box x=24..232,y=20..172.

reference_images.usage: same distinctive single mossy boulder, same natural palette and pixel style; zoom out to reveal the complete top and base surrounded by transparency
